trials.claim: Subpage provides the simplest way to create lead magnets, gate content and collect leads, now powered by AI
trials.claimQuote: The simplest way to create lead magnets, gate content and collect leads. Now powered by AI.
trials.reasoning: Two reviews show the core gating fails in both directions: real users submit information but often cannot access the promised content, while a fake email in an incognito tab unlocks it immediately. This materially undercuts the claim that it reliably gates content and collects leads, despite one positive review about ease and AI.

exhibits.quote: We use Subpage to gate lead magnets, but too often people submit their information and still can't access the content they were promised.
exhibits.argument: This shows the core gating and lead-collection flow fails because users give info but do not receive promised content.

exhibits.quote: Went to the page in an incognito tab and signed up with a fake email and immediately accessed the content.
exhibits.argument: This shows gating does not validate leads because fake emails instantly unlock content.

exhibits.quote: Use different methods to collect leads like forms, gated content forms (you can gated files), pop-up, top bar, and other widgets.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes multiple gating and lead-collection methods matching the claim.

exhibits.quote: Using Subpage has made creating lead magnets a breeze! The intuitive editor and AI features save me so much time.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms simple lead-magnet creation with working AI features.
